title: Scope expansion token
description: The consumer's biometric reconfirmation activating Expanded Scope for one inquiry session (§9.2), signed with the Tier 1 key; the top-level `signature` is over the canonical token without it. Reference proposal: AFSP v0.1 leaves this format to the Technical Working Group (§18); this schema documents the reference implementation's proposal and is not normative AFSP.

authorization_token_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical authorization token this expands.
